param_input_item.param_description: a character vector or scalar string: the group name. It must be a valid variable name.
a character vector or scalar string: one preference name, or a cell array of character vectors or a string array: several preference names. Each name must be a valid variable name.
any value when pref is a single name, or a cell array with one value for each name when pref holds several names.

description.p: addpref(group, pref, value) creates the preference pref in group and stores value in it. The group is created when it does not exist yet.

The value can be of any type that Nelson can save (numeric, logical, text, cell, struct, ...). Preferences are written immediately in the file preferences.nh5 of the preferences directory (see prefdir), so they are still available in the next Nelson session.
addpref does not overwrite: an error is raised when one of the preferences already exists in the group. Use setpref to create or replace a preference.
When several names are given, value must be a cell array with the same number of elements, otherwise an error is raised.

example_item.example_item_description: Create a group with two preferences, read them back, then remove the group.
